items.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.
